responsibility: Exports the public intrinsic header for the e500 Signal Processing Engine. It defines the SPE vector types and opaque aliases, publishes the builtin names for SPE fixed-point, floating-point, load/store, predicate, and SPEFSCR access operations, and provides convenience macros and helpers for compare/select predicates, rounding mode control, and SPE status-bit access so user code can program SPE instructions through a stable C interface.
same_name_distinction: This is the public SPE intrinsic header for source code, defining SPE vector types, builtin-name macros, predicate helpers, and SPEFSCR access helpers. Unlike spe.md, it is not the backend RTL description for generating ev*/efs*/efd* instructions.
